item.title: [提供予定・ロードマップ] Microsoft Power Platform ガバナンスおよび管理：Maker Guidelines
item.description:
Product: Microsoft 365 Copilot
Status: Roadmap
Importance: medium

Maker guidelines機能により、組織はCopilot Studioのメーカーに対して作業フロー内で直接ガイダンスを提供できるようになります。管理者は、承認されたツール、モデル、コネクター、チャネルを説明し、ポリシーやサポートへの案内を表示することが可能です。このメッセージはCopilot Studio内のReviewペインに表示され、メーカーは作業を離れることなく組織の期待事項の把握やサポートへのアクセスが行えます。

  • 管理者が環境内で承認されているツール、モデル、コネクター、チャネルを説明するガイダンスを提供可能に
  • ポリシー、リクエストプロセス、サポート連絡先への案内を表示
  • メッセージがエージェントのブロッカーや警告と並んでReviewペインに常時表示される機能を追加

Original Source

item.title: [提供予定・ロードマップ] PowerPoint: Copilot向けの非同期通知機能
item.description:
Product: Microsoft 365 Copilot
Status: Roadmap
Importance: medium

PowerPointでのCopilotの処理完了や確認事項について、ユーザーがアプリを離れたり、デバイスを切り替えたり、オフラインになったりした後でも通知を受け取れるようになる機能です。作業の終了や対応が必要なタイミングを確実にお知らせします。一般提供（GA）は2026年10月を予定しています。

  • PowerPointでのCopilotの処理について非同期通知を有効化
  • アプリの終了、デバイスの切り替え、オフライン移行、作業終了後でも通知を受信可能
  • 作業完了時や要対応時にユーザーへ通知を送信

item.title: [Roadmap] Dynamics 365 Field Service: Microsoft Copilot in Field Service Mobile app
item.description:
Product: Microsoft 365 Copilot
Status: Roadmap
Importance: low

Microsoft Copilot in the Dynamics 365 Field Service mobile app brings conversational AI chat capabilities directly to frontline workers. Once enabled, technicians can ask natural-language questions about Dynamics 365 Field Service data and receive contextual answers based on the app experience and their organization’s Dataverse data. With standard capabilities, Dataverse Q&A supports questions such as “What is the work history of this asset?” or “Who worked on this job last?” Organizations can also extend the with custom experiences and agents available to frontline and back-office users. GA date: February CY2027

item.title: [Roadmap] Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Federated Copilot Connectors will support write, update and delete actions
item.description:
Product: Microsoft 365 Copilot
Status: Roadmap
Importance: low

Federated Copilot connectors (MCP type) currently let Microsoft 365 Copilot read data from third-party services in real time. With this update, the connector tools that create, update, and delete content in those services are unblocked in Copilot Chat, so users can complete work without leaving Copilot. Copilot acts with the user's own account and permissions at the third-party service, and every create, update, or delete action requires the user's explicit confirmation before it runs. Admins can view each connector's read and write/delete tools in the Microsoft 365 admin center and disable connectors that don't meet their organization's policies. GA date: October CY2026

Original Source

item.title: [Roadmap] Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Local inferencing
item.description:
Product: Microsoft 365 Copilot
Status: Roadmap
Importance: low

Local inferencing expands Microsoft Copilot’s sovereign controls by enabling AI inferencing for supported Copilot interactions to occur within the applicable local geography. Launching in Australia, India, the United Arab Emirates, the United Kingdom, and the United States, this capability gives organizations greater control over where AI inferencing occurs, helping them address sovereignty and regional requirements. Inferencing is the processing step when an AI model executes a prompt to produce an output or response. GA date: December CY2026

Original Source

Once enrolled, users can be recognized in supported Teams Rooms experiences, helping identify who is in the room and improving downstream meeting experiences such as Copilot and recap. Admins can enable or disable the feature for their organization. GA date: November CY2026

item.title: [Roadmap] Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management-Legacy Teams retention policies covering Copilot will be treated as Teams-only
item.description:
Product: Microsoft 365 Copilot
Status: Roadmap
Importance: low

Some existing retention policies scoped to Microsoft Teams may currently also apply to Microsoft 365 Copilot interactions. As part of an upcoming change, these legacy Teams retention policies will be converted to—and treated as—Teams-only policies. They will no longer implicitly govern Copilot workloads. GA date: October CY2026

item.title: [Roadmap] Microsoft Purview: DSPM-Copilot Readiness and Data Explorer
item.description:
Product: Microsoft 365 Copilot
Status: Roadmap
Importance: low

We’re introducing the new readiness for Microsoft Copilot and data explorer experiences in Microsoft Purview Data Security Posture Management (DSPM). These new capabilities provide data security teams with greater visibility into their organization’s data security posture and help them assess risks, investigate findings, and prioritize remediation. The readiness for Microsoft Copilot experience in Purview DSPM helps organizations assess and improve their data readiness for Microsoft Copilot. It brings together insights into sensitive data exposure, oversharing, and protection coverage, helping security teams identify risks and assess progress toward a more secure Microsoft Copilot deployment. The new data explorer experience in Purview DSPM provides a centralized investigation experience that helps organizations understand where sensitive data exists across sites, review site-level access, and explore relevant data through preset views. It brings together sites, sensitive data, and preset views, to support more efficient investigations and reduce context switching. GA date: January CY2027 Preview date: November CY2026

Original Source

item.title: [Roadmap] SharePoint: Changes to the FAQ web part authoring experience
item.description:
Product: Microsoft 365 Copilot
Status: Roadmap
Importance: low

The SharePoint FAQ web part will provide a standard, non-AI experience for manually creating, editing, and managing FAQs. The AI-assisted FAQ creation and import will move to the Copilot in SharePoint authoring experience, where authors can use natural-language prompts and selected grounding sources to generate FAQ content that is saved to the compatible FAQ web part. Existing FAQ web parts and their content will continue to render without migration. GA date: October CY2026

item.description:
Product: Microsoft 365 Copilot
Status: Roadmap
Importance: low

The new Meeting Shared Files feature allows users to add relevant files and links to their meeting for easy access and to automatically share that content with all meeting participants. AI in the meeting, like the Facilitator agent, uses these files for targeted grounding to answer questions and enhance skill functionality. GA date: November CY2026

item.title: [Roadmap] Microsoft Viva: Copilot Analytics - Agent value insights in Agent 365 Dashboard
item.description:
Product: Microsoft 365 Copilot
Status: Roadmap
Importance: low

Customers can now view value insights in the Agent 365 Dashboard in Microsoft Viva Insights (Copilot Analytics). These insights help business leaders and change and adoption specialists understand not only whether agents are being used, but also the estimated assisted hours agents provide and the types of work contributing to that value. This update builds on the existing Agent 365 Dashboard adoption experience by connecting agent activity with a clearer view of the work agents support across the organization. GA date: October CY2026 Preview date: September CY2026

Original Source

item.title: [Roadmap] Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention for Microsoft Cowork
item.description:
Product: Microsoft 365 Copilot
Status: Roadmap
Importance: low

Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention (DLP) is expanding to Microsoft Cowork, enabling data security admins to use a single policy across Microsoft 365 Copilot and Cowork. The integration helps protect sensitive AI interactions by preventing the use of labeled knowledge sources, blocking prompts that contain supported sensitive information types, and restricting sensitive prompts from being sent to Bing for web search. GA date: October CY2026 Preview date: September CY2026

Original Source

item.title: [Roadmap] Microsoft Copilot Studio: Deliver rich interactive app experiences in Copilot Studio agents
item.description:
Product: Microsoft 365 Copilot
Status: Roadmap
Importance: low

Copilot Studio agents can now render rich, interactive UI inline using MCP Apps, an extension of the Model Context Protocol. When an agent calls a UI-enabled tool from a compatible MCP server, interactive experiences like sortable tables and drilldowns render directly in the conversation. Users can now explore and act on data without leaving the chat or switching tools. A plain-text fallback keeps the agent working on surfaces that can't render the UI, and makers get this simply by connecting a compliant MCP server. GA date: November CY2026 Preview date: October CY2026

Original Source

item.title: [Roadmap] Microsoft Copilot Studio: Streamlining experiences from Copilot Studio Agents in Microsoft 365 Copilot
item.description:
Product: Microsoft 365 Copilot
Status: Roadmap
Importance: low

This update is meant to bridge the experience of using Copilot Studio agents in M365 Copilot with the Copilot Chat experience. With these updates, agent responses in Copilot Chat will look (similar formatting, compressed chain of thought), feel (smoother streaming, resume/retry and voice dictation) and behave (deliver clickable citations and tool execution traces) very similarly to Copilot Chat responses themselves. GA date: September CY2026

Original Source

item.title: [Roadmap] Microsoft Copilot Studio: Enabling makers to require human approval for tool calls
item.description:
Product: Microsoft 365 Copilot
Status: Roadmap
Importance: low

Copilot Studio now let’s makers require human approval before an agent runs specific tools. With a per-tool, per-agent toggle, any gated tool call pauses and shows an approval request describing what the agent intends to do, so a person can approve, approve for the session, or deny before the action runs. This gives organizations a deterministic guardrail for high-stakes or sensitive operations like sending emails, closing tickets, or processing payments, independent of the agent's instructions. Approval requests appear inline in the channel where the agent is deployed, including Microsoft Teams and Microsoft 365 Copilot. GA date: September CY2026

Original Source

item.title: [Roadmap] Microsoft 365: Organizational Data Service is now available in GCC-High
item.description:
Product: Microsoft 365 Copilot
Status: Roadmap
Importance: low

We’re excited to announce that Microsoft 365 Organizational Data Service is now available in the GCC-High (GCC-H) environment! Microsoft 365 Organizational Data Service enables rapid ingestion of organizational/HR data through connectors from multiple HRIS systems using a single unified ingestion point. This service also provides organizational data for use across Microsoft Copilot and Microsoft 365 apps to power various features with robust data quality framework that detects, communicates, and provides solutions for data quality issues before data is used. GA date: September CY2026

Original Source
